info.name: Data API Usage Metrics API
info.description: The Data API provides web3 application developers with multi-chain data related to Avalanche's primary network, Avalanche subnets, and Ethereum.

item.name: Get usage metrics for the Primary Network RPC

query.description:
Time interval granularity for data aggregation for subnet
     rpc metrics
The start time of the range as a UNIX timestamp. The requested start time  will be rounded down to 0:00 UTC of the day.
The end time of the range as a UNIX timestamp. The requested end time will be rounded down to 0:00 UTC of the day.
Query param for the criterion used for grouping metrics
Filter data by response status code.
Filter data by request path.
Filter data by Country. Input must be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. "XX" - Represents clients without country code data. "T1" - Represents clients using the Tor network.
Filter data by Continent. Input must be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 continent code.
Filter data by User Agent.
Filter data by RPC method.
(Required) Either mainnet or testnet/fuji.

request.description: Gets metrics for public Primary Network RPC usage over a specified time interval aggregated at the specified time-duration granularity.

response.name: Successful response

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

query.description:
Time interval granularity for data aggregation for subnet
